string.text: Light knife slash on a dead mutant Uses the corpse (loot claims and auto-loot stay with existing mods). On success, plays one FDDA harvest pickup if you are still looking at the body. Setup turns off FDDA Redone skinning anims and enables auto-loot-all. Do not enable Faster Skinning's "Slash to loot mutants" at the same time.

When on, a knife light attack on a mutant corpse synthesizes Use after loot-claim mods may veto. Free bodies loot via FDDA auto-loot-all; claimed bodies keep stock PDA tips. Skin cut anims are suppressed; one harvest pickup plays if loot succeeded and the corpse is still targeted.
Wait this long after a successful slash-loot before playing the FDDA harvest pickup, so the knife swing can finish. 0 plays immediately.
